hero_kpi_rationale: Data Center revenue, powered by generative AI and Blackwell architectures, is NVIDIA's main growth driver, representing the majority of its revenue and capturing the global AI adoption wave.

kpis.signal: Massive growth driven by Blackwell and generative AI
High margin despite a decline tied to H20
R&D focused on AI innovation and new architectures
Capex sharply up to support data center infrastructure
Strong headcount growth to support expansion

risks.title: Dependence on AI and accelerated computing demand
Heightened competition from hyperscalers' proprietary ASICs
Critical dependence on CUDA and ecosystem fragmentation risk
Manufacturing capacity and semiconductor supply chain
Fast product cycles and technology obsolescence risk

ai_positioning.summary: NVIDIA is the undisputed leader in AI infrastructure, with technological dominance through its GPUs, CUDA ecosystem, and integrated data center platforms. Its Blackwell architecture has become the standard for AI training and inference.

tagline: Pioneering accelerated computing to solve the world's most challenging computational problems
